_note: direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for the registrars, trackers and recurring
assessments the section's footnotes point to.
official  registrars, regulators, commissioners, committees, prosecutors
research  influence tracking, money-in-politics research, investigations
press     general news across the locales
The section's own research list is the obvious thing to add here, with URLs
you have opened: OpenSecrets, InfluenceMap, the Revolving Door Project,
RevolvingDoorWatch, LobbyFacts, the Sunlight Foundation archive, and the OECD
